newsitem.title: USA: USTrails FY oper loss $2.1mln vs $14.6mln.
newsitem.headline: USTrails FY oper loss $2.1mln vs $14.6mln.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) NOTE: Full company name is USTrails Inc

The company said the net results included a $1.4 million extraordinary gain on the repurchase of secured notes and a $5.9 million one-time gain from reduction in the allowance for doubtful accounts and the reversal of a contingency liability.
The net results for the 1995 year include $3.7 million of nonrecurring income from a reduction in the allowance for doubful accounts and the reveral of a contingency liability.
The company said results improved on relatively flat revenues because of decreased expenses, especially in campground operating costs and interest.
Revenues were stable despite declining membership dues revenue and interest income because of higher gains from asset disposition in fiscal 1996, it said.
